### Problem

The release candidate v7.14.0 fails the release scenarios `draft-in-conflict`, `ready-behind-main`, `merge-queue`, `low-risk-merges`, `play`, so the lane releases nothing and `v7` stays where it is.

The cause, seen in the reviews of the scenarios' pull requests (https://github.com/DiluxOne/diluxone-test/pull/1193, https://github.com/DiluxOne/diluxone-test/pull/1195): each pull request changes nothing against main. A scenario's fixed change writes the same file with the same text on every run (`scenarios/draft-in-conflict/conflict.md`, `scenarios/ready-behind-main/behind.md`, and the files of `low-risk-merges` and `merge-queue`), and an earlier run merged it into the test repository's main (DiluxOne/diluxone-test#1012, #967). The diff is empty, so the review's policy floor is high ("no changed files could be listed"), and nothing merges.

### Scope

- The cause of each failing scenario above (`draft-in-conflict`, `ready-behind-main`, `merge-queue`, `low-risk-merges`, `play`), in the engine or in the scenario's fixtures, fixed with a test that would have caught it.

### Out of scope

- Changing the gates or what they check.

### Acceptance criteria

- C1: Given v7.14.0's candidate with the fix, when the release lane plays `draft-in-conflict`, `ready-behind-main`, `merge-queue`, `low-risk-merges`, `play` in the test repository, then each passes and the lane releases it.
- C2: Given a scenario whose fixed change writes a file under scenarios/<id>/ (tests/release/scenarios.yml), when two runs of the lane play it, then the text each run writes differs from the other's and from the test repository's main (it carries the run's id), and scripts/release-scenarios.py --test fails when two runs would write the same text.

### Criticality

Critical
